findings.current: He hadn’t heard a sound or detected any particularly strong movement, yet he could see everything happening beneath the table as clearly as if it were in front of him.
findings.defect: The draft makes Jeok Cheongang the subject who failed to detect movement and then says he could literally see beneath the table. The source says Taekyung made no sound or conspicuous sign, yet Jeok knew exactly what he was doing.
findings.rationale: This preserves both the omitted subject and the intended demonstration of Jeok Cheongang’s extraordinary perception without inventing literal sight.
findings.replacement: I hadn’t made a sound or given away my movement, yet he knew exactly what was happening beneath the table.
findings.source: 소리가 난 것도 아니고 기척을 크게 낸 것도 아닌데, 탁자 밑에서 벌어지는 일을 훤히 꿰뚫고 있다.

findings.current: It was impossible to tell how old it was. The paper had been crumpled and folded countless times, and its color had faded to yellow. Even so, the face of the young man drawn on it was easy to recognize.
findings.defect: The draft turns an emphatic description of the paper’s age into uncertainty about its age and adds that it had been folded countless times.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly describes an obviously old, thoroughly crumpled, yellowed sheet but says nothing about repeated folding.
findings.replacement: The paper was extremely old, crumpled all over, and yellowed with age. Even so, the face of the young man drawn on it was easy to recognize.
findings.source: 얼마나 오래됐는지, 온통 꾸깃꾸깃 구겨진 데다 누렇게 변색되어 있었지만, 그 위에 그려진 젊은 청년의 얼굴은 쉽게 알아볼 수 있었다.

findings.current: Even while a dozen or more people surrounded him and stomped him into the dirt, he shoved a dirt-covered dumpling into his mouth.
findings.defect: The draft adds the result that the attackers stomped him into the dirt. The dirt modifies the dumpling in the source, while Jangcheon is simply being trampled.
findings.rationale: This retains the simultaneous trampling and eating without adding a physical result absent from the source.
findings.replacement: Even while a dozen or so people surrounded him and trampled him, he shoved a dirt-covered dumpling into his mouth.
findings.source: 십수 명에게 둘러싸여 밟히면서도 흙투성이가 된 만두를 입 안에 쑤셔 넣더군.

findings.current: I liked the look in his eyes. At the same time, I felt sorry for him.
findings.defect: The draft omits the fierce, hardened quality of Jangcheon’s gaze, which is the specific trait that appealed to Jeok Cheongang.
findings.rationale: 독한 characterizes the boy’s tenacity and helps establish why Jeok Cheongang took an interest in him.
findings.replacement: I liked the fierce look in his eyes, and at the same time, I felt sorry for him.
findings.source: 독한 눈빛이 마음에 들었고, 한편으로는 안쓰러웠다.

findings.current: I gave him the name Jangcheon.
findings.defect: The draft romanizes the newly introduced name but omits the meaning explicitly supplied by the source’s hanja.
findings.rationale: The parenthetical 長天 conveys the name’s meaning, which is otherwise inaccessible to an English reader.
findings.replacement: I gave him the name Jangcheon, meaning “Vast Sky.”
findings.source: 나는 녀석에게 장천(長天)이라는 이름을 붙여 주었다.

findings.current: To an orphan abandoned by the world who had lived amid contempt and hunger, a martial artist was an existence no different from a god in the heavens.
findings.defect: The draft introduces a god comparison absent from the source. The image is one of martial artists occupying an impossibly elevated station, not divinity.
findings.rationale: 하늘 위의 존재 preserves the perceived social and martial elevation without adding a religious comparison.
findings.replacement: To an orphan with no one in the world, raised amid contempt and hunger, martial artists might as well have lived above the heavens.
findings.source: 온갖 멸시와 굶주림 속에 살던 천애 고아에게 무림인이란 하늘 위의 존재나 다름없었다.

findings.current: I had been listening quietly. Now I asked with an uneasy expression,
findings.defect: The draft changes the explicit third-person narration after the scene break back into first person.
findings.rationale: The source deliberately identifies Jin Taekyung in third person within Jeok Cheongang’s narrated history.
findings.replacement: Jin Taekyung, who had been listening quietly, asked with an uneasy expression,
findings.source: 가만히 듣고 있던 진태경이 떨떠름한 얼굴로 물었다.

findings.current: That was the most painful mistake he had made in the nearly one hundred years since his birth.
findings.defect: The draft changes the stated duration from a full hundred years to less than a hundred.
findings.rationale: 장장 백 년 explicitly gives the span as one hundred years; “nearly” alters the quantity.
findings.replacement: That was the most painful mistake he had made in all the hundred years since his birth.
findings.source: 그건 그의 탄생부터 지금까지, 장장 백 년의 세월 중 가장 뼈아픈 실수였다.

findings.current: He had been gone for several days, saying he was entering closed-door cultivation.
findings.defect: The draft says Jangcheon had actually been gone for several days. The source says only that he had not shown himself for several days while claiming to be in closed-door cultivation, which is why Jeok Cheongang did not know he had left.
findings.rationale: The distinction preserves Jangcheon’s deception and Jeok Cheongang’s mistaken belief that his Disciple was secluded nearby.
findings.replacement: He hadn’t shown himself for several days, claiming to be in closed-door cultivation.
findings.source: 폐관 수련을 한다며 며칠째 안 보이던 녀석이 저 아래에서 올라오더군.

findings.defect: The draft again changes the scene’s explicit third-person narration into first person.
findings.rationale: The source names Jin Taekyung as the third-person subject.

findings.defect: The draft changes the explicit third-person subject and viewpoint back into first person.
findings.rationale: This preserves the source’s third-person narration while rendering the reaction naturally.

summary: The draft contains two critical factual alterations, several viewpoint and subject shifts, and localized omissions or additions affecting characterization and mechanics.
